overview.about: The Texas Children's Houston Open is a long-standing PGA Tour event now played at the revamped Memorial Park municipal course near downtown Houston. A Tom Doak redesign brought a strong, strategic public-course test back to the professional calendar.
overview.nextEvent: The next Texas Children's Houston Open is played at Memorial Park Golf Course in Houston. The redesigned muni offers wide options off the tee and firm, undulating greens.
